run the fleet

Usage:
  ops [flags] <command>

Commands:
  note    add a note
  exec    run a command
  run     run a command on a host

Data:
  Commands that read a document from standard input.
  import    import tasks
  upper     upper-case lines (experimental)

Deploying:
  Commands that change what runs where.
  Each one asks before it acts.
  deploy    ship a service (beta)

Help Topics:
  filters        how filters work
  environment    the environment variables ops reads

Flags:
  -h, --help    print help

Output:
  Flags that shape what ops prints.
  -v, --verbose         say more (repeatable)
      --color string    when to color (default auto) [auto|always|never]

Environment:
  OPS_TOKEN string    the API token (length >= 20)
  OPS_LOG string      the log level [debug|info|error]
                        debug    everything
                        info
                        error    failures only

Configuration:
  region (region) string      the default region (beta)
  profile (profile) string    the output profile [short|long]
                                short    one line each
                                long     every field
